verses.text: Paul, Silvanus and Timothy, to di church of di Thessalonians wey dey inside God our Papa and Lord Jesus Christ:
Grace and peace from God our Papa and Lord Jesus Christ dey with una.
Brothers, we must always thank God for una, as e suppose be, because una faith dey grow well well, and di love wey each one of una get for each other dey increase,
so tay we self dey boast about una for di churches of God, because of una patience and faith for all una persecution and di sufferings wey una dey endure.
Dis na clear sign of God righteous judgment, so that dem go count una worthy of God Kingdom, wey una dey suffer for.
Because e dey righteous for God side to pay back suffering to dem wey dey make una suffer,
and to give rest to una wey dey suffer with us, when Lord Jesus go show from heaven with im mighty angel dem inside burning fire,
as e go punish dem wey no know God, and dem wey no obey di Good News of our Lord Jesus.
Dem go pay di price: destruction wey no dey end, from di face of Lord and from di glory of im might,
when e come to receive glory inside im holy people, and make all dem wey don believe wonder at am, because una believe di testimony wey we give una, for dat day.
For dis reason we dey always pray for una too, make our God count una worthy of una calling, and make e complete every good desire and every work of faith with power,
so that di name of our Lord Jesus go get glory inside una, and una inside am, according to di grace of our God and Lord Jesus Christ.
Now, brothers, about di coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and how we go gather together to am, we beg una
make una no shake quick for una mind or get fear, whether by spirit, or by word, or by letter wey dem say na from us, say di day of Lord don come.
Make nobody deceive una for any way, because dat day no go come until di turning away come first, and di man of sin show, di son of destruction,
wey dey oppose and lift imself up against everything wey dem dey call God or wey dem dey worship; so tay e go sit for God temple like God, as e dey show imself say e na God.
Una no remember say when I still dey with una, I tell una dese things?
Now una know wetin dey hold am back, so that e go show for im own time.
Because di mystery of lawlessness don dey work already. Only one person dey hold am back now, until dat person go comot from di way.
Den di lawless one go show, wey Lord go kill with di breath of im mouth, and e go finish am with di brightness of im coming;
na dis one coming go dey like Satan work, with all power and signs and lying wonders,
and with all wicked deceit for dem wey dey perish, because dem no receive di love of di truth so that dem go save.
Na why God dey send dem strong error, so that dem go believe lie,
so that all dem wey no believe di truth but dey enjoy wickedness go face judgment.
But we must always thank God for una, brothers wey Lord love, because God choose una from di beginning for salvation through di Spirit wey make una holy and through belief for di truth,
wey e call una go through our Good News, so that una go receive di glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
So, brothers, make una stand firm and hold di teaching dem wey we teach una, whether by word or by letter.
Now make our Lord Jesus Christ imself, and God our Papa wey love us and give us comfort wey no dey end and good hope by grace,
comfort una heart and make am strong for every good work and word.
Finally, brothers, pray for us, make di word of Lord run fast and get glory, just as e dey with una,
and make God save us from wicked and evil men; because no be everybody get faith.
But Lord dey faithful, and e go make una strong and guard una from di evil one.
We get confidence for Lord about una, say una dey do and una go do wetin we command.
Make Lord lead una heart enter di love of God and enter di patience of Christ.
Now we command una, brothers, for di name of our Lord Jesus Christ, make una comot from every brother wey dey live without order and no follow di teaching wey e receive from us.
Because una know how una suppose follow us. We no live without order among una,
and we no chop anybody food without we pay for am, but we work hard night and day so that we no go be load for any of una;
no be because we no get di right, but to make we self example for una so that una go follow us.
Because even when we dey with una, we command una say, “If anybody no wan work, make e no chop.”
Because we hear say some people dey among una wey dey live without order, wey no dey work at all, but dey meddle for people matter.
Now dem wey dey like dat, we command and urge dem for Lord Jesus Christ, make dem work quietly and chop dem own food.
But una, brothers, no tire to do good.
If anybody no obey our word for dis letter, make una mark dat person, make una no join am, so that shame go catch am.
No count am as enemy, but warn am as brother.
Now make Lord of peace imself give una peace at all times and for every way. Make Lord dey with una all.
Na me, Paul, write dis greeting with my own hand, and na di sign for every letter. Na so I dey write.
Di grace of our Lord Jesus Christ dey with una all. Amen.
